After seeing 👀 this documentary I better understand why several people I've met left Uganda 🇺🇬 & came here to study medicine.  The opportunities   just aren't there. My 🐕 dog has staked out her place in my lap so I'm going to watch another documentary from who knows where.  I can go around the world 🌎 without a plane ticket.
